name: Stable Diffusion 1.5

licence.name: CreativeML Open RAIL-M
licence.note: The card names the licence. The commercial-use flag reflects the licence's general terms (commercial use with use-based restrictions) and was not re-checked for this profile.

resolution.note: No aspect buckets are published, so none are listed.

sampling.steps.note: The card evaluates at 50 PNDM steps, a scheduler sd.cpp lacks; 20 to 30 is the common setting.

sampling.cfg.note: The card evaluates CFG from 1.5 to 8 and recommends none.

warnings.message: At CFG 1 or below there is no unconditional pass, so the negative prompt has no effect.

notes: Inpainting needs the separate SD1.5 inpainting checkpoint, so this profile does not list inpaint; that checkpoint would be its own variant or family.
Defaults marked unconfirmed are the common community settings the research named; no primary source recommends them.
